name: Create one or more environment variables
description: Create one or more environment variables Create one or more environment variables for a project by passing its `key`, `value`, `type` and `target` and by specifying the project by either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL. POST /v10/projects/{idOrName}/env
context:
POST /v10/projects/{idOrName}/env
Create one or more environment variables for a project by passing its `key`, `value`, `type` and `target` and by specifying the project by either passing the project `id` or `name` in the URL. If you include `upsert=true` as a query parameter, a new environment variable will not be created if it already exists but, the existing variable's value will be updated.
Required: idOrName (path) — The unique project identifier or the project name; body (body)
Optional: upsert (query) — Allow override of environment variable if it already exists; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
